title: Server & OS Administration
description: Build, harden, and troubleshoot the servers that run business applications. Tests Windows Server documentation, Linux hardening, and performance investigation.

seo.overviewBody: System administrators maintain server uptime, system performance, and operating system security. Hiring managers seek candidates capable of administering both Linux (Ubuntu/RHEL) and Windows Server environments, automating tasks with Bash/PowerShell, and managing disk storage.

deliverables.title: 1. OS Hardening & Server Setup Spec
deliverables.desc: System hardening guide covering SSH key authentication, UFW/iptables firewall settings, and service disabling.

deliverables.title: 2. Automated Admin Bash/PowerShell Script
deliverables.desc: Automated maintenance script handling OS updates, disk cleanup, and service status checks.

deliverables.title: 3. Server Performance & Uptime Benchmark
deliverables.desc: Performance monitoring report analyzing CPU utilization, memory pressure, and disk I/O metrics.

faqs.question: Why is SSH passwordless key authentication safer than passwords?
faqs.answer: Cryptographic SSH keys resist brute-force dictionary attacks, cannot be easily guessed, and can be further protected with passphrase passkeys.

faqs.question: What is the function of systemd in modern Linux distributions?
faqs.answer: Systemd is an init system and service manager that bootstraps the user space, manages background daemons, and logs system events via journalctl.

faqs.question: How do you automate server maintenance tasks?
faqs.answer: Linux uses cron jobs (/etc/cron.d), while Windows Server uses Task Scheduler to trigger automated PowerShell or Bash scripts on recurring schedules.
